products.title: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by Afnan Perfumes. It was created by perfumer Gaël Montero it is a fruity-aromatic scent with a playful yet classy touch. The perfume opens with juicy pineapple, fresh green apple and sweet mandarin (top notes). The middle notes combine creamy vanilla, oakmoss and cedarwood for a smooth balance. Finally, the base leaves a warm trail of ambergris, dry woods, caramel and musk that lingers beautifully.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Black Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance from the house of Rasasi. Launched in 2024, this scent feels fresh, fruity and woody at the same time. It starts with delightful pineapple, vibrant bergamot and tangy grapefruit, which give a clean and energetic feeling. The middle of the fragrance already shows patchouli, cedar and a hint of jasmine, making the perfume slightly rich and slowly earthy. The strong and warm base is made up of oakmoss, woody notes and amber that linger on the skin for many hours.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and somewhat spicy perfume that suits both the women and men. It starts with an appetising blend of mango and lemon that is refreshing and cheerful, and it is spiced a little by ginger. Tones become light and sweet as it subsides with floral notes of praline such as jasmine and violet. Tonka bean, woods and moss make the base warm and smooth and thus comfortable and lasting. This smell is contemporary, comfortable, and very satisfying.

products.title: Afnan  Modest Une Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Modest Une Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance that was launched in 2019. It is an aromatic spicy combination made for men who like fresh, bold and long-lasting perfumes. The opening comes with sharp pepper, soothing lavender, cool mint and spicy nutmeg. The middle notes bring citrus, warm amber and refreshing eucalyptus. The base is masculine with musk, vetiver and cedarwood giving it depth and strength that stays for hours.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2025, this fragrance opens with juicy and citrusy notes that feel clean and energetic. As it settles, soft florals and fruity tones come out, making it smooth and pleasant. The warmth of musk, amber and vanilla in the base gives the perfume a balanced, easy everyday fragrance.

products.title: Ajmal Kuro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Kuro is designed for the modern Indian gent who wants the punch of a designer perfume without the designer price tag. The first spray bursts open with cool bergamot and lively pepper, giving a crisp “wake‑up” feel that cuts through humidity. Just seconds later, elegant French lavender and bright geranium step in, smoothing the edges and adding a clean, shirt‑fresh vibe. Deeper down, earthy vetiver, patchouli, and a whisper of ambergris ground the scent and help it cling to skin and fabric long after sundown. Think of it as a confident handshake that turns into an all‑day friendship, easy to like, hard to forget, and perfect for the office, college campus, or a late‑night drive.

products.title: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Its launch in 2024 revealed the mixture of spicy, citrus, and woody notes in a fresh and elegant perfume. The composition starts with the lively cardamom, ginger, bergamot, and lemon that serve the energetic and clean opening. Lavender, geranium, and mint form the middle, with their soft, herbal, and calming touch added to the composition. The base is composed of amber, cedarwood, patchouli, and vetiver that create a warm and smooth long-lasting dry down on skin.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Ghost Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Ghost Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern woody aromatic scent made for men who like strong yet clean perfumes. It opens fresh and spicy with ginger, cardamom and bergamot, giving a sharp, energetic start. The heart turns slightly sweet and spicy with pink pepper, blackcurrant and rose, adding depth and smoothness. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, cedarwood and patchouli, which stays on skin for hours, feels classy but not heavy.

products.title: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Shiyaaka Shadow Eau de Parfum is a bold, oriental, spicy male perfume that opens fresh and slightly sharp, featuring notes of grapefruit and pink pepper. A clean touch is added by lavender, followed by warmth and richness from amber and cedarwood. Patchouli, moss and musk are used in the dry down to form an even, long-lasting dark base. It is powerful, contemporary and suitable for self-confident men who prefer luxurious evening perfumes.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and modern scent made for men who like simple but classy perfumes. It begins with very refreshing minty and juicy citrus with a cool feeling and lots of energy. It gradually goes to soft and spicy middle notes that are then followed by smooth and soft woody and musky base notes that remain on the skin.

products.title: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy, unisex perfume from Paris Corner fragrances. Launched in 2023, it carries a bold oriental scent style built with black pepper, elemi and pink pepper in the opening; olibanum and saffron in the heart; and a smooth base of vanilla and cedarwood.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Le Parfum is the ultimate expression of modern masculinity, confidence, and success. This fragrance is a deep, intense, and incredibly smooth take on the iconic Y signature. It masterfully balances vibrant freshness with a powerful, dark elegance, creating a scent that is both bold and sophisticated.

Y Le Parfum smells like ambition in a bottle. It opens with a fresh burst of crisp apple and zesty grapefruit, then settles into a clean, aromatic heart of lavender and sage. The real magic happens in the base, where warm tonka bean and rich woods provide a deep, long-lasting trail that feels luxurious and powerful. It’s the perfect fragrance for the man who is bold, ambitious, and carves his path.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and modern unisex fragrance that beautifully blends fruity sweetness with soft floral touches and warm woody notes. Inspired by royalty and calm blue skies, this scent opens with juicy pear and sweet citrus notes that instantly lift your mood.

At its heart, Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum blooms with freesia and rose, giving a clean and graceful floral vibe. The base is warm and comforting with soft musk and smooth cedarwood, adding depth and a gentle touch of luxury that stays with you all day.

If you love fragrances that feel light yet royal, Azure Royal is a perfect choice for daily wear, special dinners, and every moment you want to feel fresh and confident.

products.title: French Avenue Aether Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aether Extrait de Parfum is a cool and smooth perfume that targets both women and men. It begins with a pure fruit-like touch of green apple combined with fresh bergamot and mandarin that are refreshing and uplifting. Resting down, soft wood and violet emerge and give the smell a tranquil and harmonious smell. The foundation is musky and a little earthy, leaving a natural and long lasting finish, which is easy to wear and modern.

products.title: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep scent for men. It’s a warm oriental-woody perfume that mixes spicy, sweet and smoky tones beautifully. The fragrance opens with cinnamon, lavender and mandarin for a spicy-fresh start. The middle brings soft iris, cypress, benzoin and floral mahonial. The base settles into creamy vanilla, tonka, amber, incense, cedarwood and patchouli giving a rich and warm trail.

products.title: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Lattafa. It is a classy and modern scent with a nice mix of citrus, woods and spice. The perfume opens fresh with lemon, bergamot, clary sage and juniper berries, giving a cool and clean feeling. As it settles, white tea, sandalwood, cardamom and olibanum bring warmth and smoothness. The dry down has ambergris, cedarwood, cashmeran and patchouli that make it deep, cozy, and long-lasting.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a dessert style fragrance profile made with pistachio, ice cream, bergamot, hazelnut, cardamom and rum (top notes); pear, jasmine, peony, geranium, raspberry and white peach (heart notes) and whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, tonka bean and cedarwood (base notes) blended softly into a playful and smooth composition with gourmand sweetness and fruity floral touch that feels cozy and addictive.

products.title: Versace Eros Eau De Toilette
products.body_html:
Versace Eros Eau De Toilette is a bold, fresh, and sensual men’s fragrance inspired by Greek mythology and the god of love, Eros. This fragrance is designed for the strong, passionate man who lives life with confidence and desire.

The scent opens with a burst of cool mint, crisp green apple, and juicy lemon, giving an instant feeling of freshness and energy. The heart of Versace Eros Eau De Toilette adds warmth with sweet tonka bean, soft ambroxan, and aromatic geranium. In the base, rich Madagascar vanilla blends with strong cedarwood, vetiver, and oakmoss to create a masculine, long-lasting finish.

Versace Eros Eau De Toilette is the perfect choice if you want to feel powerful, attractive, and unforgettable.

products.title: Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Shiro Eau De Parfum is a sharp, fresh, and energetic fragrance designed for the modern man who lives life on the go.1 The name "Shiro," meaning white in Japanese, perfectly captures its clean, crisp, and confident vibe. This perfume is an amazing mix of fresh fruits, cool watery notes, and warm woods that makes you feel instantly refreshed and ready to take on the day.

Shiro smells modern yet timeless. It has the energy of a summer morning and the confidence of a sharp suit. It’s the perfect choice for men who want a versatile, high-quality scent that works for every occasion, from the office to a casual day out. A few sprays of Ajmal Shiro will leave you smelling clean, magnetic, and effortlessly stylish.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy woody fragrance for women and men. It opens with a strong mix of cinnamon, cardamom and a little citrus touch of mandarin. After some time, it becomes sweeter with caramel and soft lavender. The base feels deep and rich with amber, woods and vetiver, giving a bold and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Khadlaj Fursan White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Fursan White Eau de Parfum is a perfume used by women. Fursan White was launched in 2024. Bergamot and Jasmine are the top notes, Musk, Coconut and Almond are the middle notes, and Vanilla, Cedarwood and Nutmeg are the base notes. It starts with fresh bergamot and a slight touch of jasmine that is clean and bright. After several minutes, coconut and almond arrive, adding musk to it, making it feel milk-like. Vanilla, cedarwood and nutmeg are present in the dry down to provide a warm and soft spicy feel. It is stylish, comfortable and highly comfortable.

products.title: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is a bold, powerful, and intense fragrance crafted especially for the modern gentleman. Launched in 2024, Bvlgari Man in Black parfum is a deeper and richer version of the original Man in Black line by Bvlgari. It opens with a smoky spice that immediately catches attention, followed by warm leather, deep resins, and creamy vanilla. This fragrance is designed for men who want to leave a lasting impression with a scent that feels both luxurious and masculine. Whether you’re heading to a formal evening or a winter brunch, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is your perfect statement fragrance.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombré Leather Parfum is an intense, velvety, and daring leather fragrance that exudes sophistication and luxury. It starts with a delicate green hint of violet leaf and dry cedar, then gradually transitions to a pure floral heart with jasmine and orris. The foundation is a blend of leather, wood notes, and a faintly tobacco-like smell, which are all three very strong. This fragrance gives off a powerful, self-assured, and contemporary vibe which is ideal for those who are fans of leather perfumes with a strong presence.

products.title: Lattafa Fire on Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fire On Ice Lattafa Perfumes is an Oriental Vanilla perfume for both men and women. This is a new fragrance. Fire On Ice was launched in 2025. Lattafa Fire On Ice Eau de Parfum is an aggressive, cozy and slightly sweet fragrance that makes the perfume feel rich immediately after spraying it. The fruity and spicy kick is brought out by the opening of cognac, raspberry and cinnamon. Some time later, soft rose petals and creamy caramel begin to appear and give it sweetness. The depth, warmth and powerful lasting power are provided by oak, myrrh, cedarwood and ambroxan in the base. It is warm, rich and comfortable to wear in the evening.

products.title: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum is a strong and dominant perfume for men with warm, fruity, and deep notes. The introduction is a pleasant fruity mix that is infused with rose and saffron to produce a smooth but slightly spicy taste. The robust oud evolves over time with patchouli and benzoin in order to establish a complex, dark atmosphere. The bottom part of the combines leather and wood materials with soft fabrics and creates a long-lasting and powerful smell that comprises vanilla and amber.

products.title: Burberry Hero Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Hero Parfum is a heavy and cosy men's fragrance that is intense, woody and contemporary. The perfume opens with a calm and soft mix of amyris that brings about a peaceful and tranquil introduction of wood. The middle part brings in the rich cedarwood that brings out the pungent scent of a strong, masculine matter. There is a base layer that consists of cypriol oil, giving it a long-lasting dry earthy smell that lingers on the skin all day. This is a confident, powerful, and manly perfume that is suitable for men who prefer woody fragrances.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette is a cheerful, fresh, fun and lively women’s fragrance that literally encapsulates summer. Light Blue opens bright and transparent with a shocking burst of Sicilian lemon, Granny Smith apple, cedar, and soft bellflower akin to the scent of an early cool morning soft breeze; incredibly pleasant! Light Blue has a slight playful nature, while bamboo, jasmine, and rose enhance its buoyancy and elegance. Light Blue dries down smooth and enjoyable with cedarwood, clean musk, and a gentle bit of amber, leaving a subtle but long-lasting impression on your skin.

products.title: Diptyque Orpheon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is a classy, modern unisex fragrance that feels warm, cozy, and stylish all at once. Inspired by the lively nights of Paris in the 1960s, Orphéon evokes memories of jazz bars, wooden furniture, and powdery notes reminiscent of soft skin and warm drinks.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh, slightly spicy touch of juniper berries, which feels crisp and clean. The heart of jasmine adds a gentle floral note that balances beautifully with the warm base of powder, cedarwood, and smooth tonka bean.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love fragrances that feel both fresh and comforting. This perfume feels like wearing a stylish blazer with a soft scarf, easy, elegant, and always inviting.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum is a prosperous and bold men's perfume from the house of Rabanne. It launched in 2023 and is a deep, warm scent made with spicy, woody and leathery notes that feel royal and strong. It begins spicy and fresh using saffron, nutmeg, black pepper and bergamot. The middle is a smooth mixture of woody patchouli, gurjan balsam and sandalwood. The base is dark, warm and long lasting, using oud, leather, cedarwood and labdanum.

products.title: French Avenue Moonstone Noire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Moonstone Noire Eau de Parfum is a dark, smooth and classy unisex fragrance from the house of French Avenue. Launched in 2024, this scent focuses on deep leather tones mixed with woody and creamy notes. The fragrance opens softly and slowly becomes creamy and warm, making it perfect for people who like bold but balanced perfumes.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Aariz is a modern, fresh, and exquisite fragrance designed for everyone. It perfectly captures the feeling of a cool, gentle breeze on a warm day. Aariz is a scent that feels both sophisticated and comforting, blending bright, happy notes with a soft, clean heart.

Aariz smells like confidence and charm in a bottle. It has a beautiful freshness that makes it easy to wear, while its rich base gives it a character that is hard to forget. It’s the perfect choice for those who want a signature scent that is unique, versatile, and consistently receives compliments. One spray of Aariz makes you feel polished, modern, and ready for anything.

products.title: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Aromatix X Carnal Desire Extrait de Parfum is a powerful and enticing perfume that is suitable for women and men to use. It starts off with a sweet, fruity raspberry smell that is mixed with fresh bergamot and light cinnamon spice. The aroma becomes sweet, creamy and comprises cotton candy, soft rose, and powdery orris. The dry down has a thick, dense fragrance that mixes leather, oud, vanilla, and wood notes that last long after application in the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Fierte Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Fierté Eau de Parfum is a bold, warm women’s perfume for those who love deep, spicy and slightly sweet scents. Launched in 2024, this perfume opens with a smoky mix of incense, tobacco and saffron, which feels creamy and confident from the first spray. As it settles, spicy notes mix with elemi and dry cedarwood, giving it a smooth, classy feel. The base is soft and comforting with vanilla, benzoin and tonka, leaving a long lasting, cozy trail that feels elegant and strong at the same time.

products.title: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Sherif Eau de Parfum is a fresh and woody men's perfume, which is clean, smooth, and classy. It begins with the ripe apple and sunny bergamot touch that is vigorous and crisp. Gradually, the heart is made more of cedarwood and soft violet, so that it feels rather peaceful and slightly dusty. On its foundation, oakmoss, musk, and amber provide a very cosy and lasting effect. It is stinking of modernity, confident, and easy to wear.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex perfume with a strong oriental touch. It starts with a fruity and spicy mixture of mango, saffron, citrus and soft florals that are bright but warm at the same time. The middle note is amber, rose, iris and black tea that are smooth and slightly smoky. The base is deep, woody and very long lasting with oud, tonka bean, patchouli, musk and cedar, which gives it a bold and classy finish that feels lavish but is still easy to wear.

products.title: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spicy Amber Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold and cozy fragrance made for both men and women. It starts with a creamy blend of incense and coffee, which has a hint of rose that provides a nice beginning. The cedar and cashmere wood make the heart stiff and chilly, which gives the scent a rich texture. As it dries down, Spicy Amber becomes creamy and slightly sweet with vanilla, mixed with earthy vetiver and clean musk.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Babycat Raw Bourbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Babycat Raw Bourbon Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is an Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Babycat Raw Bourbon was launched in 2025 and the nose behind this fragrance is Dominique Ropion. The scent opens with a spicy mix of black pepper and pink pepper that feels warm and sharp. The heart brings rich notes of saffron, olibanum and resins which give a smoky and deep character. In the base, vanilla, suede and cedarwood create a smooth, warm and long-lasting finish that feels luxurious and bold.

products.title: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum is a powerful and mysterious leather scent that is unisex. The fragrance begins with a delicate combination of plum, cardamom, and fresh citrus that is warm and somewhat spicy. Gradually, rose, nutmeg, and cinnamon unfold revealing a profound and elegant character. At the end of the process, leather, oud, and incense remain robust and smoky. The impression received from this fragrance is dauntless, sumptuous and just right for self-assured perfume users.

products.title: Fragrance World Francique 63.55 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Francique 63.55 Eau de Parfum by Fragrance World is a smooth, cosy, and oriental woody perfume that is produced to suit both genders (women and men). It is sophisticated, serene and soothing to the initial spurt. The fragrance starts with subtle spice, then gradually transitions into creamy and classy, and then long-lasting, sweet woody base. The perfume is ideal for those who enjoy the use of soft, warm, and comfortable perfumes to wear daily and evenings.

products.title: Dumont Paris Nitro Platinum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nitro Paris Platinum Eau de Parfum is a contemporary woody fragrance perfume targeting men who prefer serious and sweet perfumes. It begins with a fresh and juicy combination of spices and fruits that is vibrant and vigorous. Gradually, it becomes warm and smooth vanilla, sugar, and soft woods. The foundation is deep, creamy, and long-lasting with a great and assertive feel. The perfume seems trendy, very expensive and can be worn daily or on nights.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum is one of the most up-to-date and daring perfumes created for men's self-assurance. The initial impressions are of purity and vigor felt through the fresh and spicy notes. Gradually, the sweetness of lavender and earthiness of wood mingle to exude a gentle and tranquil aura. The final stage is warm, sugary, and faintly milky owing to the presence of vanilla and Balsam. This fragrance is interpreted as trendy, manly, and very persistent, an ideal match for the strong but soft perfume lovers.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Sandalwood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sandalwood by Ibraheem Al Qurashi is a warm, soft, and slightly sweet Oriental Floral perfume that suits both women and men. It opens with a juicy combination of raspberry and deep damask rose, creamy and smooth. The middle adds a powdery touch, combined with dry cedarwood, giving the scent a calm, elegant feel. The base is creamy, warm, and comforting with amber and strong sandalwood that stays long and feels very cosy. It is a simple, classy, and relaxing perfume loved by many who enjoy soft woody scents.

products.title: Acqua Di Parma Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Acqua di Parma Leather EDP for men and women is a sophisticated and luxurious evening perfume with a rich citrusy opening with Brazilian orange, Sicilian lemon, and raspberry top notes; aromatic and leather-balancing red thyme, rose, petitgrain, and honeysuckle heart notes; and a polished base of leather, cedarwood, and guaiac wood. It was formulated by François Demachy in 2019. 

It is highly praised among the fragrance community as a highly refined and exceptional blend of notes with a distinguished quality and satisfactory projection & sillage.

products.title: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum is a sweet, playful women’s perfume. It opens with a strong cherry feel that smells juicy, a little boozy and slightly nutty. As it settles, soft fruits and florals come out, making it feel romantic and smooth. The base is warm, creamy and comforting with vanilla and woods that stay close to the skin. This perfume feels fun, cozy and perfect for someone who loves sweet cherry based scents.

products.title: Amouage Decision Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Decision Eau de Parfum is a modern woody aromatic fragrance made for both men and women. This perfume is deep, calm and confident in nature. A fresh and spicy opening leads into a warm, resinous heart which ends with a gentle, woody base. Amouage released this fragrance in 2025, which perfumes people to express their unique personality.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum is a profound, shadowy, and mighty aroma that imparts richness and smokiness. At the top, a powerful whiskey accord is the major player, giving a daring and alcoholic accent first. Gradually, spicy resins like cinnamon and coriander join in and heat things up. When it comes to the base note, the combination of tobacco and oud with incense and different types of woods results in a thick and opulent scent. This fragrance is bold, strong, and sophisticated at the same time and is made for those who like strong and adult-like perfumes.

products.title: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and dignified perfume targeted at women who enjoy heavy and sophisticated aromas. It starts with a spicy bite of saffron and black pepper blended with fresh bergamot, and it is bold as one sprays the perfume. Gradually the odour turns warm and silky, including iris, balsam and soft woods. Its foundation is solid and lavishly oud, leather, patchouli, and sandalwood, with a long-lasting and superior touch

products.title: Louis Vuitton Lovers Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Lovers Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern woody aroma made for men who enjoy clean, warm and stylish scents. The fragrance begins with bright green galbanum and smooth bergamot and then moves to a warm blend of ginger and soft solar notes. The dry-down is made of creamy sandalwood and clean cedarwood, which gives the perfume a simple but classy character, a scent that is calm, light and easy to wear every day.

products.title: Givenchy Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum for women is a warm, elegant, and sensual fragrance that is classic and feminine. The first notes are spicy nutmeg, fresh bergamot, sweet gardenia, and soft flowers, then it is rich heart comprising tuberose, jasmine, iris, honeysuckle, and peony. The drydown is a mix of vanilla, amber, cedarwood, guaiac wood, and soft woods making it creamy and deep. The fragrance is described as a timeless scent with a smooth sweet and floral blend, which is ideal for women who prefer a bold but elegant perfume.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Roses Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Rose Vanille Eau de Parfum is an alluring, sweet, and romantic fragrance created for the women who prefer floral and creamy scents. It starts with a fresh lemon note that is light and clean on the skin. A very rich rose note gradually comes into play and feels soft and classy. The base notes of vanilla, white musk, and cedarwood impart warmth, sweetness, and comfort that are close to the skin for a long time.

products.title: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a robust, warm fragrance that feels incredibly cozy and almost addictive. It opens with a smooth blend of tobacco, juicy plum, and spicy ginger, leading to a smoky yet fruity beginning. As the fragrance evolves, you find a rich heart of cloves, creamy tonka bean, and dry cedarwood that adds a depth of richness and texture. The base wraps itself in warm vanilla, benzoin, and earthy vetiver and leaves a soft sweetness with just a gentle smokiness after the dry down.

products.title: Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold, magnetic, and modern fragrance for men who want to make a lasting impression. As the most intense version in the Boss Bottled line, this scent takes the iconic DNA and turns it into a richer, deeper, and more luxurious experience.

From the very first spray, Boss Bottled Elixir feels powerful yet smooth opening with the spicy freshness of cardamom and the smoky elegance of frankincense. As it develops, earthy patchouli and vetiver step in, adding depth and masculinity. Finally, warm labdanum and dry cedarwood create a strong, long-lasting base that feels sophisticated and confident.

This is not just a fragrance, Boss Bottled Elixir is a statement of strength and charisma. Whether for an important meeting, a date night, or a grand celebration, this scent makes sure all eyes are on you.

products.title: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur EDP is a bold, truly sensual choice. It works for everyone—men and women. The scent is famous for its warm, spicy, and deep musk feel. Maurice Roucel created Musc Ravageur in 2000. It opens with fresh energy. You first smell lavender, tangerine, and bergamot. That clean burst soon fades. The center quickly moves to a rich mix: cinnamon, cloves, and rose. This makes the perfume smooth. It gives a light, powdery touch. The base is where it locks down. Expect deep warmth here. Musk, vanilla, amber, and woods dominate. This strong finish makes Musc Ravageur unforgettable. It feels cozy; it feels mysterious. The scent is known for staying warm and strong on your skin all day.

products.title: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, clean and classy men’s perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent is made for men who like a neat, modern and confident smell. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel fresh and energizing, then slowly moves into soft florals and green tones. Smooth, warm and slightly creamy with woods, musk and vanilla is the base, which gives a polished touch but at the same time is suitable for everyday wear.

products.title: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html:
Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and refreshing fragrance made for royalty and for those who live like one. Inspired by the Duke of Windsor and the upscale Mayfair district in London, this scent feels luxurious, clean, and crisp. It perfectly blends aromatic, floral, and green notes with a soft woody base to create a refined signature scent.

Creed Royal Mayfair smells like confidence in a bottle. It starts fresh and sharp, thanks to British gin and lime, and then flows into sweet rose and smooth eucalyptus, finishing with soft cedarwood. Whether you’re heading to a formal dinner, an office meeting, or a classy brunch, Royal Mayfair will leave a polished and sophisticated impression.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace Noir Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance with a fresh, fruity and slightly spicy feel. It was introduced in 2024 and opens bright and juicy with apple and citrus notes that feel clean and energetic. As it settles, warm spices and soft florals come out, giving it depth and character. The base is smooth and creamy with vanilla and woods, making it comforting and classy at the same time.

products.title: Ex Nihilio The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilio The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum is a strong woody scent made for both men and women. The scent was made by Jordi Fernández in 2024. The top notes are grapefruit, some spicy ginger, and bright bergamot. The middle note mixes Akigalawood, juicy lychee, and cedarwood, which gives it a warm, rich feel. The base rests on soft amberwood, dirt-like vetiver, patchouli, and smooth tonka bean, so the smell lasts a long time and feels totally balanced.

products.title: Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum is a deep, modern, and soulful fragrance that invites you on a journey of discovery. It’s more than just a scent; it’s an experience. Crafted for the confident individual, this perfume mix of warm spices, rich woods, and a hint of nutty sweetness to create a truly unforgettable aroma.

Reasons smell like finding comfort in sophistication. It wraps you in a warm, elegant embrace that is both powerful and peaceful. This fragrance is perfect for those who want a signature scent that tells a story of wisdom, confidence, and quiet strength. With Amouage Reasons, you don’t just enter a room, you bring a unique and captivating presence with you.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and modern unisex perfume from the house of Arabiyat Prestige. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels bright and playful but also warm at the same time. It begins with rich fruits and citrus flavors, which are vibrant and vivid. As it settles, soft florals and a creamy sweetness start to show, making it smooth and pleasing. The base is warm and woody and a little sweet, making the perfume to be in balance and very comfortable.

products.title: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sospiro Vibrato Eau de Parfum is a fresh and luxurious perfume for men and women. The initial spray is light and energetic, containing grapefruit and bergamot as a sharp citrus touch. Jasmine and magnolia bring soft smoothness to the flower, therefore, it is balanced and clean. Light spice and warmth are introduced as it settles with ginger and herbal notes. The musk, cedar, amber, orris root, and patchouli base provide a creamy woody finish, which lasts many hours. It is very memorable, luxurious and very contemporary and lightweight.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Hedonist Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilo Hedonist Eau de Parfum is a smooth, woody-smelling fragrance that is targeted at both men and women. At the same time, it is clean, fresh, and warm. The smell starts fresh and a bit spicy, and gradually turns woody and tender. It is not overpowering, but it is good and opulent to touch. This perfume is ideal for individuals who enjoy sophisticated, contemporary and durable scents that are relaxing and assured.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is refreshing and fragrant but still in the wood category, and it is designed for both female and male. It starts with a bright mix of mandarin and cardamom which is blended in a clean and spicy way. While it is getting prepared to settle down, soft jasmine, and woody notes take over, which creates a smooth and classy atmosphere. The base of oud, patchouli, musk, and cedarwood adds richness and longevity. This fragrance feels luxurious, contemporary, and comfortable to wear.

products.title: Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum is a radiant and sophisticated unisex fragrance that feels like liquid sunshine on the skin. A modern masterpiece from the House of Amouage, this scent is designed to evoke a sense of pure elegance and a radiant aura. It beautifully balances warm spices, soft florals, and creamy woods to create a fragrance that is both comforting and captivating.

Amouage Lustre smells incredibly luxurious yet is easy to wear. It has a rich depth and a warm glow that makes you feel special and confident. It’s the perfect choice for those who love modern, elegant fragrances that leave a lasting, memorable impression. One spray of Amouage Lustre will wrap you in a golden embrace, making you feel polished and effortlessly chic.
